feeds.title: Calvin's Story
feeds.description: Calvin's Story is the blog I write about being the mother of my eight-year-old boy Calvin, who has intractable epilepsy. My mission is to increase epilepsy awareness, dispel the myths, promote understanding and inspire empathy, all in hope of a cure.

feeds.title: Life with a Livewire
feeds.description: Hi! My name is Taz, and I have two smart girls, one of whom has epilepsy. Because I enjoy writing and want to share our experience raising a child with epilepsy and a learning handicap, I started this blog. In addition, I wish to spread knowledge about epilepsy, its manifestations, and its consequences.

feeds.title: Keto Hope Foundation Blog
feeds.description: Read the blog to learn about the experiences of amazing mothers who have epileptic children on how their lives have transformed as a result of incorporating the ketogenic diet as a form of pediatric epilepsy treatment. Keto Hope Foundation is a nonprofit founded in 2016 dedicated to raising awareness and advancing the ketogenic diet for the treatment of pediatric epilepsy one family at a time.

feeds.title: Seizure Mama and Rose
feeds.description: Read Seizure mama and rose an epilepsy memoir of a mom sharing stories of her daughter surviving and thriving with epilepsy.

feeds.title: Elizabeth Aquino
feeds.description: Click to read Elizabeth Aquino, a Substack piece by a mother who writes about caregiving, disability, and keeping herself motivated while supporting her epileptic child in her fight.

feeds.title: Sonya's Story
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Ema, the mother of my late daughter Sonya, and this is my account where I relate my dear baby's struggle with epilepsy and how perspective can transform your life.

feeds.title: Mickie's Miracles Blog
feeds.description: The blog shares the experiences of moms of epileptic children and aims to raise global awareness of pediatric epilepsy through education, activism, and support so that families can receive the best possible care and an immediate diagnosis.

feeds.title: SeizingHope.com
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Jill, Haley's mother, and Seizing Hope is where I share my experiences of being a divorced mother, navigating the challenging waters of parenting in general, and occasionally losing my bearings in the world of raising a kid with epilepsy.

feeds.title: The True Superman » Epilepsy
feeds.description: Hi! I am Dylan's mother. My son, Late Dylan, battled epilepsy, and this blog has continued to track his path as a genuine hero even after his passing.

feeds.title: Brain Blips
feeds.description: This Brain Blips blog follows the epilepsy journey of a mother who set out on a trip to see her daughter battle epilepsy and win.

feeds.title: CDKL5 News
feeds.description: The battles mothers and their kids have with epileptic encephalopathy are chronicled in this blog. The International Foundation for CDKL5 is a non-profit organization that provides the most current information on treatment advances and strives to raise awareness of this rare disorder within the medical and lay communities.
